Northwestern Wolf: very large powerful gray wolf with long legs, deep chest and big paws; thick grizzled gray, tan and cream coat, pale cream underside and legs, darker saddle on the back; broad head, erect triangular ears, bushy tail hanging straight down
Eurasian Wolf: large lean gray wolf with long legs; grizzled gray-brown and tawny coat, cream throat, belly and inner legs, dark line on the front of the forelegs; erect ears, bushy tail hanging down
Arctic Wolf: stocky white wolf with slightly shorter legs and small rounded ears; thick pure white to creamy white fur all over; short muzzle; bushy white tail hanging down
Mexican Wolf: medium-sized slender wolf; mottled gray, rusty tan and black coat, tawny-buff legs, cream underside; erect ears, bushy tail with black tip hanging down
Iberian Wolf: medium-sized lean wolf; reddish-brown and gray coat with white markings on the upper lips, dark vertical stripes on the front of the forelegs; erect ears, bushy tail with dark tip hanging down; calm expression with mouth closed, no teeth visible
Indian Wolf: small slender long-legged wolf with short coat; sandy reddish-buff to grayish coat, pale underside; large erect ears; thin tail hanging down
Arabian Wolf: small, very slender desert wolf with long thin legs and very large erect ears; short thin pale sandy beige coat; narrow head; thin tail hanging down
Ethiopian Wolf: slender long-legged canid with a long narrow muzzle; bright rusty red coat, white throat, white chest patch and white underside, white inner legs; pointed erect ears; bushy tail with a black tip
Red Wolf: medium-sized slender wolf with long legs and large ears; cinnamon reddish-tan coat on the head, ears and legs, grayish-black back; cream throat and muzzle; tail hanging down with black tip
African Golden Wolf: small slender jackal-like canid with long thin legs and large pointed ears; golden yellowish to grayish coat with darker back, pale underside; bushy tail with black tip hanging down
Coyote: slender medium canid with narrow pointed muzzle, large erect ears and long legs; grizzled gray-brown and tawny coat, reddish legs and ears, cream throat and belly; bushy tail with black tip carried low
Dingo: medium-sized lean dog-like canid with a wedge-shaped head and erect ears; short ginger sandy coat with white feet, white chest and white tail tip; bushy tail carried low
Dhole: medium-sized compact canid with short legs, rounded erect ears and short muzzle; bright rusty red coat, pale cream throat and belly; bushy black tail
Maned Wolf: fox-like canid with extremely long thin black legs and very large erect ears; reddish-orange coat, black mane on the back of the neck and shoulders, black legs like stockings, white throat and white tail tip; long narrow muzzle
